run_upload_gtest: run upload_gtest.py to upload a Google Test patch for review with automatic CC
run_upload_gtest_with_cc: run upload_gtest.py with custom CC flags to add extra reviewers to the patch upload
run_upload_gtest_wrapper: run the upload_gtest.py wrapper script that delegates to upload.py with the gtest group CC'd
review_main_function: review the main function that parses CLI args and appends the gtest group to the CC list
summarize_upload_gtest: summarize the upload_gtest.py script which wraps upload.py and auto-CCs the googletestframework group
